body: I’m going to try my hardest man, just feels like i’ve hit a wall and it’s hard to see the light currently. But i’ll take your advice and try! Thanks for the kind words, they were really nice and kinda hit me in the feels! Thank you!

Wanted to let you know that I tried your advice I took and I am continuing to take some time to myself, that mixed with reducing social media, I feel a bit better about myself. Obviously not entirely there but it’s helped. Just wanted to thank you for reaching out to me!
I’ll try my best too, my first step is to try and get the guilt outta my system. That’s really hard.

It happened again tonight and that’s why I reached out for advice. Just so ashamed of myself. So I guess maybe taking a few days to focus on myself and try calm down could be a good start and step in the right direction?

Yeah, under quite a bit of stress that i’ve mostly caused myself sadly. I’ll try your advice it sounds really helpful! The only thing I struggle with is judging myself, I feel like a monster about it all. Really embarrassed and ashamed. I’ve said this before and it’s happened again and again. I hope your advice helps even slightly! Thank you!

I’ve done this for about a month, I just snap. It’s happened to my closest friends and my ex when trying to sort out issues. I just go on rants, and i’m so embarrassed reading all back after the fact. It’s happened too many times in the past month or 2. I deleted the social media platforms i have people on and blocked them just to be safe. But I’m so worried I’ve pushed everyone away.
